sections.name: Psychoanalysis
covered: Read Jonathan Lear on Freud: Freud stumbled on a developmental push inside each person toward relating to the world rationally.
Aristotle on anger: anger is a response to a slight, being treated as if I don't matter, and it moves us toward revenge.
